title: Direct-Booking Waiver of Deposit Handling Fees — Room Reservations
content:
**Term.** On the deposit handling fee charged when money held on a Room Reservations reservation is refunded after a no-show, a reservation booked directly with Ashbury, through the brand website, the mobile app, the call center or the hotel itself, that carries an active Ashbury Rewards membership has the member direct-booking share of 40% of the fee waived; one booked directly without an active membership has the guest direct-booking share of 20% waived; a reservation booked through any other channel has no direct-booking waiver (0%).

**Q. Which channels are direct?**
The brand website, the mobile app, the call center and property direct, as the booking channel on the reservation record shows. Online travel agency, travel agency through a global distribution system and group rooming list bookings are not direct.

**Q. What is an active membership here?**
The Ashbury Rewards membership attached to the reservation, with the status active. No membership attached, or a suspended or closed one, counts as booked without an active membership.

**Q. Where does the waiver act?**
It takes its share off the fee charged on the refund, as that fee then stands, and before the fee is taken off the refund.

| Channel | Active membership attached | Share waived |
|---|---|---|
| Direct | Yes | 40% |
| Direct | No | 20% |
| Any other | either | none |

**Q. What does it come to?**
On a hypothetical fee charged of 25.00, as it then stands: booked on the brand website with an active membership, 15.00 remains; booked by phone at the call center without a membership, 20.00 remains; booked through an online travel agency, 25.00 remains.
